item.title: Looking back at the Closer Tour in Holland and Belgium - Wilde Life
item.description: Kim Wilde toured the Netherlands and Belgium over the last two weeks; 12 concerts in 11 different cities. A look back on a great tour.

item.title: Happy birthday to Kim! - Wilde Life
item.description: Today, on 18 November 2025, Kim Wilde celebrates her 65th birthday! Also,the BBC will broadcast the best of her TV performances this weekend.

item.title: Kim Wilde at the BBC - Wilde Life
item.description: On 22 November Kim Wilde fans were treated to a 90 minute special called Kim Wilde at the BBC in which performances by Kim were shown.

item.title: Kim drops music video for 'Scorpio' - Wilde Life
item.description: The music video for the new single 'Scorpio' premiered today. It is a compilation of images from the Closer Tour, filmed in 2025.

item.title: Happy 2026 from Wilde Life - Wilde Life
item.description: Welcome to 2026. Wilde Life has a very small update on what to expect during the next twelve months for Kim Wilde fans.

item.title: Deluxe edition of 'Close' out in March - Wilde Life
item.description: On 13 March 2026, Kim Wilde’s sixth studio album Close will be released as a deluxe 2cd+dvd edition in the style of the recent re-releases of Love Moves, Love Is…

item.title: Marty announces new album! - Wilde Life
item.description: Marty Wilde has announced a new album today, titled Let's Rock This Place. The album will be released on 17 April 2026.

item.title: Kim Wilde Singles Tour in 2027 - Wilde Life
item.description: Today Kim Wilde has announced a new tour for next year. It's called the Singles Tour and the first dates will take place in March 2027 in the United Kingdom.

item.title: Marty releases 'Your Loving Touch' - Wilde Life
item.description: Marty Wilde has released the second single off his forthcoming album Let's Rock This Place today. It's called 'Your Loving Touch'.

item.title: Deluxe edition of 'Teases & Dares' out in June - Wilde Life
item.description: 19 June 2026 sees the release of Kim Wilde's fourth studio album 'Teases & Dares' as a deluxe 2cd+dvd package, plus blue vinyl and picture disc vinyl editions.
